evidence: firmware_acceptance/kit.py: AcceptanceBroker.materialize_seed writes the five target seed files read-only before Git initialization.

firmware_acceptance/c3_harness.py: C3Harness._assignment creates a linked Git worktree, then _protected_seed_snapshot compares its modes to self.seed_identity captured from the packaged 0644 seed files.
findings.observed: Git checks the protected files out writable in the linked assignment worktree, and the snapshot accepts those writable modes.
findings.expected: The five protected seed files remain read-only and identity-bound in each candidate-created assignment worktree while the linked .git file remains permitted.
findings.reproduction: Materialize a target, create an assignment worktree through _assignment, and inspect the five protected file modes against the read-only target files; the worktree modes match the writable packaged-seed snapshot instead of the protected target modes.
findings.impact: A target worker can alter charter, pinned-input, test-contract, or evidence-schema content during its assignment and restore it before reap or acceptance.
findings.no_fix_consequence: The candidate cannot honestly claim an immutable five-file seed boundary for dispatched target work, because final content checks cannot prove the files remained protected during execution.
findings.smallest_fix: After git worktree add, mark exactly the five protected seed files read-only and bind _protected_seed_snapshot to those protected content/mode pairs before launch, reap, and acceptance.
findings.complexity: Small localized mode-binding change in the existing materialization and assignment path.
findings.regression_risk: Low: it affects only the five already protected seed files and preserves the linked .git file behavior.
findings.verification_cost: Low: a host-only worktree-mode assertion before launch and after reap covers the corrected boundary.
findings.alternatives: End-only hash checks and writable-mode snapshots do not prevent reversible in-assignment mutation; broad worktree isolation is unnecessary.
findings.cost_benefit: The localized repair restores the required immutable-seed guarantee with less complexity than any broader isolation mechanism.
